purpose: Document first-party registry/map discovery, bounded anonymous request outcomes, and safety limits.
assessment: Official Côte d’Ivoire sources evidence Daloa’s cadastral service/circonscription and current national urban and rural land information channels. No anonymous complete safe parcel polygon response with a verified native identity was obtained.
registryAssessment: The Daloa-specific official/legal publication references the service du Cadastre de Daloa and the circonscription foncière de Daloa. SIGFU is the official urban-land management system with parcel and lot search; AFOR is the official rural-land agency and its geoportal advertises parcel loading. These establish custody and public-facing procedures/channels, not open citywide parcel geometry.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Official SIGFU parcel page describes public lot/locality search and says results concern approved subdivisions; no schema or complete polygon response was retained.
Official SIGFU public landing page describes parcel/lot cartography and administrative parcel verification services.
Official AFOR rural geoportal states national overview and parcel loading at detailed zoom; no bounded feature response was obtained.
Official/legal publication text references the service du Cadastre de Daloa and the circonscription foncière de Daloa.
Official DGI Direction du Cadastre page was retrieved; it exposes an online tax-notice workflow, not a public parcel geometry service.
Official AFOR news page documents rural-land security activity in Daloa; it is contextual custody evidence, not a parcel API.

viewerConfiguration.observedTechnology: Public HTML/search-indexed viewer pages; AFOR page presents an OpenStreetMap-backed web map and parcel-loading status. No stable service configuration or API contract was verified.
observedControls: AFOR map with national overview and parcel loading
viewerConfiguration.schemaAndCrs: Not exposed by the bounded retrieval; no CRS, native ID field, or feature schema was verified.
safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel identifier if independently verified

attempts.result: Search result and page content exposed official parcel/locality search controls; direct bounded open timed out. No anonymous feature response, schema, or geometry obtained.
HTTP page content retrieved; viewer advertised national overview and parcel loading. No bounded anonymous feature response or schema obtained.
Official DGI cadastre page retrieved; only tax-notice workflow observed, with no parcel geometry route.
Official/legal publication content verified Daloa cadastral-service and land-circonscription references; no geometry request submitted.
Official AFOR page verified Daloa-specific rural-land-security activity; no parcel geometry request submitted.
TLS certificate chain could not be verified by the local curl trust store; request was not retried with verification disabled or bypassed.

geometryDecision: No full polygon retained; no qualifying safe anonymous parcel response was verified.

geometryEvidence.query: No parcel feature query was submitted because the public pages did not expose a verified anonymous endpoint/schema and one direct request encountered a TLS trust-chain failure.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Daloa cadastral-service reference plus official Côte d’Ivoire SIGFU and AFOR channels.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: No anonymous complete-polygon feature response verified.

remainingUncertainty: The SIGFU and AFOR public viewers’ current JavaScript/API routes, anonymous access policy, CRS, native identity field, returned schema, and Daloa coverage remain unverified. Timeout, TLS trust failure, general viewer text, or lack of a bounded response is not evidence of cadastral absence.

runtimeAssessment.reason: No independent anonymous ID-plus-geometry response; packet does not qualify an adapter or enable runtime.
